introduction.purpose: This Data Specification describes the business/functional data used by the Online Banking Application as required by the FRD.
introduction.scope: This specification is not a database schema. It describes functional/business data and names no tables, columns, indexes, databases, or implementation architecture.
audience: Human reviewers and approvers of functional requirements

data_entries.title: Customer Profile
data_entries.description: Business/functional identity data for a customer using the simulation.
data_entries.purpose: Supports onboarding and identifies the customer across journeys.
data_entries.notes: Exact fields and validation constraints are unresolved (see OQ-013). Identity data is synthetic (see FR-021).

data_entries.title: KYC Information
data_entries.description: KYC information supplied by the customer during onboarding.
data_entries.purpose: Supports KYC capture and bank-operations review (see FR-002, FR-011, FR-012).
data_entries.notes: KYC is captured for the simulation and is subject to no real verification (constraint CON-003). Exact fields and validation constraints are unresolved (see OQ-013).

data_entries.title: Aadhaar/PAN Information
data_entries.description: Aadhaar and PAN details provided by the customer, verified format-only and mocked.
data_entries.purpose: Supports capture of Aadhaar/PAN details without real identity verification.
data_entries.notes: Verification is format-only and mocked (CON-003, business rule BR-002). Exact fields and format rules are unresolved (see OQ-013).

data_entries.title: Account Data
data_entries.description: Customer account information used in the simulation.
data_entries.purpose: Supports account activation, transfers, and statement journeys.
data_entries.notes: Accounts are synthetic (see FR-021). Exact account data fields and account-state rules are unresolved (see OQ-006, OQ-013).

data_entries.title: Account State
data_entries.description: The state of a customer account (for example, active or frozen) as used by bank operations and customers.
data_entries.purpose: Supports account activation/freezing, transfers, and state visibility.
data_entries.notes: Exact account-state values and rules are unresolved (see OQ-006). State changes must be auditable (see FR-020).

data_entries.title: Balance Data
data_entries.description: Synthetic balance information associated with a customer account.
data_entries.purpose: Supports simulated transfer and receipt of money and balance visibility.
data_entries.notes: Balances are synthetic (see FR-021). Minimum balance and transfer-related limits are unresolved (see OQ-002, OQ-007).

data_entries.title: Beneficiary Data
data_entries.description: Beneficiary information used in the simulation.
data_entries.notes: Beneficiaries are synthetic (see FR-021). Beneficiary management itself is out of scope per the BRD; only the synthetic data used by the simulation is described.

data_entries.title: Payment/Transfer Data
data_entries.description: Records of simulated payments/transfers of money.
data_entries.purpose: Supports transfer and receipt of simulated money and statement generation.
data_entries.notes: Payments are synthetic (see FR-021); real money movement is not permitted (CON-002). Exact transfer/payment rules and limits are unresolved (see OQ-007, OQ-013).

data_entries.title: Statement Data
data_entries.description: Data needed to present and download customer statements.
data_entries.purpose: Supports customer statement viewing and download.
data_entries.notes: Exact statement content and download behaviour are unresolved (see OQ-008).

data_entries.title: Role and Access Data
data_entries.description: Data representing the two roles (Customer and Bank Operations) and the actions permitted per role.
data_entries.notes: Exact role permissions and authorization rules are unresolved (see OQ-009).

data_entries.title: Audit Trail Data
data_entries.description: Records of auditable state changes in the simulation.
data_entries.purpose: Supports auditable state changes and bank-operations access to the audit trail.
data_entries.notes: Exact audit events to be recorded are unresolved (see OQ-011).

data_entries.title: Session Data
data_entries.description: Data representing an authenticated session for a Customer or Bank Operations user.
data_entries.purpose: Supports login, logout, and role-based access.
data_entries.notes: Exact authentication and session rules are unresolved (see OQ-009, OQ-010).
